policy: Exact verified source-score exceptions preserve university-confirmed finals. Independently verified one-day date-only corrections may update the ledger and trigger full Elo replay; all changed scores, teams or unverified date differences remain fail-closed.

exceptions.explanation: Home institution's women's soccer game report explicitly documents a 1-0 final and winning goal with 1.7 seconds left. University's separate men's soccer report documents a 3-1 final on the same date against the same opponent. Do not overwrite the independently supported women's 1-0 Elo result with a potentially cross-feed or stale scoreboard score.

Hanover and Earlham official men's soccer recaps both document a 3–1 Earlham win on Tuesday November 3, 2026; the ledger entered November 4 from an earlier scoreboard date. Correct only the calendar date, preserving game ID, identity, score and one Elo application.
